doc: docs/merge-queue-settings.md. The one source for merge queue settings, approving review count and explicitly scoped required checks. Applied by scripts/apply_merge_queue.py (dry-run by default). Required checks follow the scoped first-check bootstrap in that document for an existing queue with no required contexts.

queue_required_status_checks.note: Merge queues test the combined head; do not require PR branches to be up to date. Applies only to repository rulesets carrying a merge_queue rule. Non-queue strict flags and all exclusions are preserved.

fast_gate.note: ci-ok is the CI gate. The tool reports it fleet-wide and adds or binds checks only for the explicit required_checks targets below; all other required checks are preserved.

review.note: Human approving reviews remain at zero; deterministic CI (ci-ok) is the only merge gate. require_extra_approval_for_unattributed_changes adds one approving review when a pull request carries commits GitHub cannot attribute to a user (every desk App's), which would hold every bot pull request for an approval ci-ok already made; the tool converges it to false.

overrides.reason: Preserve the existing queue settings read on 2026-11-02 while adopting the Android compilation and package gate; this rollout changes required checks, not queue capacity or grouping.

The passing native/browser merge-group gate completed 82 minutes after enqueue on 2026-11-02, beyond the 60-minute deadline. Allow 120 minutes with margin and preserve the repository's other existing queue settings and required checks.
Unity Android/iOS and backend merge-group gates run beyond the 20-minute Tier-2 deadline; preserve the game repository's live merge method, build concurrency and 240-minute deadline.
Measured Android and iOS merge-group CI ran 20 to 34 minutes on attempt 1 (2026-11-18), above the 20-minute Tier-2 deadline. Keep a 60-minute deadline while adopting Tier-2 batching.

Tier-1 high-concurrency monorepo: batch 4 to 8 entries with a 2-minute collection window and 8 concurrent HEADGREEN builds. Keep a 60-minute transition deadline until p90 gate latency stays at or below 5 minutes.

SylphxAI/infra#6081 measured 182s for merge-queue CI and 330s for PR CI (down from 943s). Remove the 2-minute collection wait so a green entry can merge alone. Keep 8 concurrent builds, up to 8 entries per merge, and the 60-minute deadline. Raise build concurrency from 8 to 16 only after measuring self-hosted runner headroom under concurrent merge-group and PR workloads.

SylphxAI/anyagents#457 replaced the old 743s macOS and 440s Linux merge-group lanes with change-based checks and parallel Linux shards. Its passing main run measured 15s for console and 81–225s per Linux shard. Allow 12 concurrent builds and up to 12 entries per merge, with no wait for a second green entry.

This existing queue had no required checks and no merge-group runs; require the observed producer first, then verify its first real merge group through the necessary delivery-manifest correction. Release remains disabled and is not activated by this policy.
